name: mercura-config-panel
description: Work with your Mercura configurators from Claude: configure products, see live prices, create quotes, look up quotes and products, and (for admins) edit configurators safely.

host.title: config-panel address
host.description: The address you log in to config-panel at, e.g. acme.config.mercura.io

password.title: Password
password.description: Your config-panel password. Kept in your computer's secure storage (Keychain / Credential Manager), never in a settings file and never shown to Claude.

allow_edits.title: Allow edits to configurators
allow_edits.description: Admins only. When on, Claude can propose changes to configurators and save them after you confirm each one.
